chunks: "Whoever Allah's blessing upon him becomes great, the burden of the people upon him also becomes intense. So preserve the blessing by bearing the burden, and do not expose it to disappearance; for seldom does a blessing depart from someone and then nearly return to him."

key_terms.فَاسْتَدِيمُوا: seek to make something continue and endure
key_terms.مَئُونَةُ: the burden, cost, or responsibility one bears for others
key_terms.نِعْمَةُ: divine blessing or favor bestowed by Allah

ai.seo_question: How can a person preserve Allah's blessings according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: The hadith teaches that great divine blessings bring corresponding obligations toward others. It urges a person to preserve blessings by carrying those burdens patiently, warning that once blessings are lost, they rarely return.
